label: Private - missing entrance signage
driver_story: I drove into the car park behind the shopping centre. There was no sign at the entrance at all, only a faded sign on a wall far inside the lot that I could not see from where I parked. I went shopping for an hour and came back to a ticket. I took photos of the entrance and the empty sign post the same day.
evidence: Photos of the entrance without any sign
Photo of where the car was parked

label: Private - paid in app, plate typo
driver_story: I paid for two hours in the parking app and have the receipt. When I typed the plate in the app I made a typo: one character wrong (CD 34 576 instead of CD 34 567). The receipt shows payment covering the time of the ticket, so I did pay for the stay.
evidence: App payment receipt covering the ticket time
Photo of the car registration certificate

label: Public - loading/unloading
reason_on_ticket: Parkering i strid med færdselstavle (parkering forbudt)
driver_story: I stopped for about 2 minutes to unload boxes of goods at a shop door, with the hazard lights on, staying by the car. My colleague stood on the pavement and saw the whole thing. The attendant issued the ticket while I was carrying boxes inside.

label: Private - forgot p-skive
location: Stationsvej 8, 2400 Testkøbing (NordPark p-plads ved Testkøbing Station)
driver_story: I forgot to put out my p-skive. I was only 10 min over the time limit and everyone else parks there anyway. I did see the signs but I did not think they would ticket for just a few minutes.

label: Private - ticketed 1 min after arrival
driver_story: I arrived at 12:30 and was walking to the payment machine when I saw the attendant already writing the ticket at 12:31, only 1 minute after I arrived. I paid in the app at 12:34, 3 minutes after the ticket time, and have the receipt with the timestamp.
evidence: Photo of the payment machine location
